description: All relays of the fleet aggregated: health, traffic, network position, geography, overload, accounting and keys. Data: tor-relay-setup fleet serve via Prometheus.

panels.description: Relays whose tor service is active, and all relays in the inventory (plus relays found on the hosts but not listed). Whole fleet.
panels.title: Relays up

panels.description: Servers whose last SSH probe succeeded, and all servers in the inventory. Whole fleet.
panels.title: Hosts up

panels.description: Findings in fleet serve's "Needs attention" list: stopped relays, unreachable hosts, lost flags, overload, accounting, keys. Open the fleet web UI for the details.
panels.title: Attention

panels.description: Traffic of all relays with a MetricsPort over the last 5 minutes: in = read, out = written. Relays forward what they read, so both are similar. The Traffic row below graphs it.
panels.title: Throughput

panels.description: Bytes all relays wrote in the last 30 days (Prometheus keeps 400 days). Starts counting when monitoring starts.
panels.title: Relayed 30d

panels.description: Time since the least recent successful SSH probe of any host. fleet serve probes every host each probe interval (30 s by default); orange after 5 minutes, red after 15.
panels.title: Oldest probe

panels.description: The fleet's share of the total consensus weight of the Tor network, summed over relays Tor Metrics lists. Roughly the share of the network's traffic the fleet is offered.
panels.title: Net share

panels.description: Probability that a client picks one of the fleet's relays as its entry guard (summed, from Tor Metrics).
panels.title: Guard prob.

panels.description: Probability that a circuit uses one of the fleet's relays in the middle position (summed, from Tor Metrics).
panels.title: Middle prob.

panels.description: Probability that a circuit exits through one of the fleet's relays (summed, from Tor Metrics). 0 for a fleet without exits.
panels.title: Exit prob.

panels.description: Sum of the bandwidth the relays advertise in their descriptors (the minimum of their rate limits and observed capacity), from Tor Metrics.
panels.title: Advertised

panels.description: Open connections to other relays and clients, summed over relays with a MetricsPort.
panels.title: Connections

panels.description: Bytes per second read (below the axis) and written (above) by all relays with a MetricsPort. Always present, also in privacy mode.
panels.title: Fleet throughput

panels.description: Bytes per second written by each relay, stacked. Filtered by host and role. Per-relay traffic and connection series are left out when fleet serve runs with privacy = true; the fleet totals stay.

defaults.noValue: No data yet, or hidden by privacy mode

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sum by (nickname) (rate(tor_relay_fleet_relay_traffic_bytes_total{host=~"$host", role=~"$role", direction="written"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Throughput per relay

panels.description: Bytes read and written by the whole fleet per day.

defaults.noValue: Daily totals appear after the first full day (UTC)

panels.title: Traffic per day

panels.description: Advertised and observed bandwidth from the relays' descriptors (Tor Metrics, hourly) next to what the fleet actually writes. A large gap between advertised and used is spare capacity.
panels.title: Bandwidth: advertised, observed, used

panels.description: One row per relay. Click a nickname for its detail dashboard. Throughput is bytes written per second over 5 minutes (empty in privacy mode); uptime counts from tor's last restart as Tor Metrics saw it; Stable/Fast/HSDir are consensus flags.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (max without () (sum without (direction) (rate(tor_relay_fleet_relay_traffic_bytes_total{host=~"$host", role=~"$role", direction="written"}[5m]))))
max without (instance, job) (max without () (tor_relay_fleet_relay_signing_cert_expiry_timestamp_seconds{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"} - time()))
max without (instance, job) (max without () (max without (flag) (tor_relay_fleet_relay_flag{host=~"$host", role=~"$role", flag="Stable"})))
max without (instance, job) (max without () (max without (flag) (tor_relay_fleet_relay_flag{host=~"$host", role=~"$role", flag="Fast"})))
max without (instance, job) (max without () (max without (flag) (tor_relay_fleet_relay_flag{host=~"$host", role=~"$role", flag="HSDir"})))

panels.title: Relays

panels.description: Prometheus alert rules that fire right now (prometheus-fleet-rules.yml). Grafana lists all rules under Alerting → Alert rules.
panels.title: Firing alerts

panels.description: Result of fleet serve's SSH probe per host: OK, no probe (tor-relay-setup missing or too old on the host) or unreachable.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (max by (host) ((tor_relay_fleet_host_up{host=~"$host", state="ok"} == 1) * 1 or (tor_relay_fleet_host_up{host=~"$host", state="no_probe"} == 1) * 2 or (tor_relay_fleet_host_up{host=~"$host", state="unreachable"} == 1) * 3))

panels.title: Host probe state

panels.description: Each relay's share of the network's consensus weight, stacked: the top line is the fleet's share. Filtered by host and role.
panels.title: Consensus weight share per relay

panels.description: How likely clients are to pick a fleet relay as guard, middle or exit (summed over the fleet, from Tor Metrics).
panels.title: Path selection probability

panels.description: The fleet's consensus weight (the bandwidth the directory authorities measured, scaled), stacked by role; the dashed line is the fleet total from fleet serve.
panels.title: Consensus weight by role

panels.description: Where the relays are, by the country Tor Metrics reports for their address. The circle size is the number of relays. The base map is loaded from CARTO by your browser.
panels.title: Relays by country

panels.description: Number of relays per country (ISO code from Tor Metrics). Diversity across countries and jurisdictions makes the network harder to observe.
panels.title: Relays per country

panels.description: Relays by role: guard (Guard flag), exit (Exit flag), middle, or bridge.
panels.title: Roles

panels.description: Relays by tor version. Several versions at once usually means some relays missed an upgrade.
panels.title: tor versions

panels.description: Number of relays per autonomous system. Many relays in one AS concentrate the fleet at one provider.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sort_desc(count by (as, as_name) (label_replace(tor_relay_fleet_relay_info{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"}, "as_name", "unknown", "as_name", ""))))

panels.title: Relays per network (AS)

panels.description: The fleet's consensus weight share by autonomous system.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sort_desc(sum by (as, as_name) (tor_relay_fleet_relay_consensus_weight_fraction{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"} * on (host, tor_instance) group_left (as, as_name) max by (host, tor_instance, as, as_name) (label_replace(tor_relay_fleet_relay_info, "as_name", "unknown", "as_name", "")))))

panels.title: Consensus weight share per network (AS)

panels.description: The fleet's consensus weight share by country.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sort_desc(sum by (country) (tor_relay_fleet_relay_consensus_weight_fraction{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"} * on (host, tor_instance) group_left (country) max by (host, tor_instance, country) (label_replace(tor_relay_fleet_relay_info, "country", "unknown", "country", "")))))

panels.title: Consensus weight share per country

panels.description: Relays Relay Search marks as overloaded: tor published overload-general in the last 72 hours (OOM, dropped ntor handshakes, or TCP port exhaustion).

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sum(tor_relay_fleet_relay_overloaded{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Overloaded relays

panels.description: Relays whose status report lists at least one problem.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (count(tor_relay_fleet_relay_warnings{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"} > 0) or vector(0))

panels.title: Relays with warnings

panels.description: ntor and ntor_v3 onionskins the relays dropped in the last 24 hours because their CPU workers were busy.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sum(increase(tor_relay_fleet_relay_onionskins_total{host=~"$host", role=~"$role", type=~"ntor|ntor_v3", action="dropped"}[24h])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Dropped, 24 h

panels.description: Bytes tor's out-of-memory handler freed in the last 24 hours (MaxMemInQueues reached).

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sum(increase(tor_relay_fleet_relay_oom_bytes_total{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"}[24h])) or vector(0))

panels.title: OOM freed, 24 h

panels.description: Share of ntor/ntor_v3 onionskins each relay dropped. From 1% over 6 hours tor reports overload-general (dashed line): give it more CPU or lower RelayBandwidthRate.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sum by (nickname) (rate(tor_relay_fleet_relay_onionskins_total{host=~"$host", role=~"$role", type=~"ntor|ntor_v3", action="dropped"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (nickname) (rate(tor_relay_fleet_relay_onionskins_total{host=~"$host", role=~"$role", type=~"ntor|ntor_v3"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: ntor handshake drop ratio

panels.description: Open sockets as a share of tor's socket limit per relay. At the limit tor publishes overload-fd-exhausted; raise LimitNOFILE.
panels.title: Socket usage

panels.description: Bytes freed by tor's out-of-memory handler per hour and relay. Shown as a rate per hour.
panels.title: Freed by the OOM handler per hour

panels.description: Connections per hour that failed because no local TCP port was free. Widen net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range. Shown as a rate per hour.
panels.title: TCP port exhaustion per hour

panels.description: How often per hour the global BandwidthRate bucket ran empty (read/write). Expected with a deliberate limit. Shown as a rate per hour.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sum by (nickname, side) (rate(tor_relay_fleet_relay_rate_limit_reached_total{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"}[$__rate_interval]) * 3600))

panels.title: Global rate limit reached per hour

panels.description: Open connections to other relays and clients per relay. Per-relay traffic and connection series are left out when fleet serve runs with privacy = true; the fleet totals stay.

defaults.noValue: No data yet, or hidden by privacy mode

panels.title: OR connections per relay

panels.description: Number of problems each relay's status report lists (tor-relay-setup status on the host shows them).
panels.title: Status warnings per relay

panels.description: Share of the accounting budget each relay used this period. tor hibernates at 100% until the period ends.
panels.title: AccountingMax used

panels.description: Budget each relay will have used when the period ends, at its pace so far. Above 100% it hibernates early: lower RelayBandwidthRate.
panels.title: Projected by the end of the period

panels.description: Bytes counted against AccountingMax this period (solid) and the limit (dashed), per relay.
panels.title: Accounting budget

panels.description: Time until each relay's accounting period ends and the budget resets.
panels.title: Period ends in

panels.description: Relays whose FamilyId set differs from the fleet majority, so clients might put two fleet relays in one circuit.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (count(tor_relay_fleet_relay_family_consistent{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"} == 0) or vector(0))

panels.title: Family mismatch

panels.description: FamilyIds in torrc without their secret family key on the relay.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sum(tor_relay_fleet_relay_family_keys_missing{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Missing keys

panels.description: The signing certificate that expires first among relays with an offline master key, which need tor-relay-setup keys renew before then. tor renews the others itself a day before they expire, so "none needed" means nothing to do.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (min(tor_relay_fleet_relay_signing_cert_expiry_timestamp_seconds{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"} and on (host, tor_instance) tor_relay_fleet_relay_master_key_offline{host=~"$host", role=~"$role"} == 1) - time())

panels.title: Renewal due

panels.description: Relays Tor Metrics lists (published) out of all relays.
panels.title: In Tor Metrics

panels.description: Each relay's FamilyIds, missing secret keys and whether its family matches the fleet majority.
panels.title: Family

panels.description: Time until each relay's ed25519 signing certificate expires; red below a day, orange below a week. tor renews it itself unless the master key is offline.
panels.title: Signing certificate valid for

panels.description: Every server fleet serve probes: probe state, tor-relay-setup version, time since the last successful probe, probe duration, and relays found.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (max without () (max by (host, state) (tor_relay_fleet_host_up{host=~"$host"} == 1)))
max without (instance, job) (max without () (max by (host, version) (tor_relay_fleet_host_tool_info{host=~"$host"})))
max without (instance, job) (max without () (time() - max by (host) (tor_relay_fleet_host_last_success_timestamp_seconds{host=~"$host"})))

panels.title: Hosts

panels.description: How long the SSH probe of each host took. Rising times point at a slow network or a loaded host.
panels.title: Probe duration per host

panels.description: Duration of fleet serve's last full probe round, and of Prometheus's scrape of fleet serve.
panels.title: Probe round and scrape

panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape fleet serve on 127.0.0.1:9850 with its bearer token.
panels.title: fleet serve scrape

panels.description: Time since fleet serve finished its last full probe round; orange after 5 minutes, red after 15.
panels.title: Last probe round

panels.description: How long fleet serve's last full probe round over all hosts took.
panels.title: Probe round duration

panels.description: Time since fleet serve last refreshed relay data from Tor Metrics (Onionoo publishes hourly).
panels.title: Tor Metrics data age

panels.description: Hosts whose last SSH probe failed to connect.
panels.title: Hosts unreachable

panels.description: Hosts where tor-relay-setup fleet-probe is missing or too old.
panels.title: Hosts without probe

title: Tor fleet — overview
